construction: hero silhouette (one shared outline of all faces) minus two tapered interlace cuts (VectorCraft Pathfinder Minus Front)

measured_in_12.profile: constant from the open end for 40 % (left-leg cut) / 60 % (right-leg cut) of its length, then a straight taper to a point

a_left_leg.along: ribbon top edge over the A left leg, open at the leg outer edge

b_right_leg_p_stem.along: ribbon outer edge over the A right leg and the P stem/bowl, open into the lower counter, closing at the P counter

vs_12.note: 12 is a separate flat drawing of the design (different proportions and P), so this is reported, not forced
